metaData.originalTitle: 从「找视频」到「产视频」：快手 RaG 推动推荐系统迈向完全生成时代
metaData.title: From 'Finding Videos' to 'Producing Videos': Kuaishou's RaG Propels Recommendation Systems into the Fully Generative Era
metaData.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou proposes the Recommendation-as-Generation (RaG) system, evolving recommendation systems from retrieving existing content to directly generating personalized videos based on user interests, with online A/B testing showing a 1.870% relative increase in ad revenue over a strong baseline.
metaData.summary: The article details Kuaishou's latest advancement in recommendation systems, RaG (Recommendation-as-Generation), which aims to break through the limitations of the traditional 'retrieve-and-rank' paradigm, shifting recommendation systems from 'finding videos' to 'producing videos'. Core innovations include: Disentangled Semantic IDs (D-SIDs), which decouple videos into content semantics and creative semantics as a unified semantic interface; Generative Recommendation Model (GRM), which autoregressively predicts user interest semantic tokens; Instruction Model, which translates semantics into shot-level production instructions; Video Generation Agents (VGAs), which organize video generation via a multi-Agent pipeline; and Synergistic Cross-Domain Reward Learning (SCRL), which incorporates user feedback, interest alignment, and video quality into closed-loop optimization. The article also elaborates on the industrial deployment architecture (online recommendation + nearline generation + cache expansion) and presents online experimental results: GRM improves upon traditional DLRMs by 3.526%, and the complete RaG further improves by 1.870% on top of GRM. Finally, the article discusses the paradigm expansion trend of recommendation systems from content distribution to content creation.

mainPoints.point: RaG advances recommendation systems from 'finding videos' to 'producing videos'.
mainPoints.explanation: By predicting user interest semantics and generating personalized videos, the recommendation system transforms from a content distributor into the upstream brain of the content production chain.

mainPoints.point: D-SIDs decouple the content semantics and creative semantics of videos.
mainPoints.explanation: By performing discrete quantization on content and creativity separately, the codebook collision rate is reduced (from 18.24% to 2.62%), providing a cleaner semantic interface.

mainPoints.point: GRM predicts interest semantic tokens rather than specific video IDs.
mainPoints.explanation: Autoregressively outputting 'generatable content intents' that can be consumed by the generation system upgrades recommendation results from candidates to production blueprints.

mainPoints.point: SCRL jointly optimizes user feedback, interest alignment, and video quality within a unified framework.
mainPoints.explanation: Using user feedback as the primary objective and treating interest alignment and video quality as constraints, it dynamically adjusts weights via PID control to avoid multi-objective RL oscillation.

keyQuotes: It pushes the boundary of recommendation systems from 'distributing existing content' to 'creating potential supply'.
From finding videos, to producing videos.
In the past, recommendation systems answered: where is the content the user wants to watch? RaG begins to answer: what should the content the user wants to watch look like?

relatedArticles.title: Wan2.7-Image: Enhanced Realism, Stable Text Rendering, and Precise Color Accuracy
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Tongyi Lab releases the Wan2.7-Image generation model, featuring significant improvements in character realism, text rendering stability, and color accuracy.

relatedArticles.title: Harness Engineering: Best Practices for Self-Optimizing C-Side AIGC Content Production
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article elaborates on how Ant Insurance's DIPG (Deep Interpretation Page Generator) system transforms C-side AIGC content delivery from uncontrollable real-time generation to controllable offline production through offline generation, a multi-Agent verification loop, and an error backfill mechanism.

relatedArticles.title: GLM-5V-Turbo Released: A Multimodal Coding Foundation Model
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Zhipu AI has released GLM-5V-Turbo, a multimodal coding foundation model that supports native visual understanding and code generation, is deeply optimized for Agent scenarios, and offers a 200k context window.

relatedArticles.title: From 3% to 80% Adoption Rate: The Evolution of Intelligent Unit Test Generation
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the practical experience of Kuaishou's R&D efficiency team in increasing the adoption rate of AI-powered unit test generation from 3% to 80% through architectural evolution (from pure LLM heuristics to a dual-driven approach of knowledge and rules).

relatedArticles.title: Kuaishou OneSearch-V2 Fully Launches, Generative Search Enters the 'Understands You' Era
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou's technical team has launched the OneSearch-V2 generative search framework, which leverages self-distillation for implicit reasoning enhancement, thought-enhanced query understanding, and preference alignment based on user behavior feedback to significantly improve click-through rates, conversion rates, and buyer numbers in e-commerce search without increasing inference costs.

relatedArticles.title: From High Fidelity to True Usability: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 Officially Open-Sourced
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Meituan has officially open-sourced LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5, a commercial-grade digital human video generation model that achieves comprehensive improvements in lip-sync accuracy, physical plausibility, long-video stability, multi-person interaction, and efficient inference.

relatedArticles.title: Interception Rate from 15% to 55%: The Evolution and Practice of Kuaishou's Intelligent Oncall System
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: This article details the evolution of Kuaishou's intelligent Oncall system, KOncall. Through a technical architecture upgrade from NLP to RAG + LLM, the construction of a knowledge operation system, optimization of core workflows, and fine-tuning of a private model, the problem interception rate was increased from 15% to 55%, achieving a shift from reactive response to root cause governance.

relatedArticles.title: 美团海报生成 AIGC 技术创新与实践
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: 美团技术团队提出 PosterCraft、PosterOmni、PosterReward 三项工作，构建“生成-编辑-评判”闭环的海报生成 AIGC 技术体系，并全部开源。

relatedArticles.title: Kuaishou's Ad System Enters the Era of Generative Recommendation! GR4AD: Full-Chain Reconstruction from Token to Revenue
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou has launched the GR4AD system, achieving full-chain reconstruction and performance breakthroughs in large-scale advertising scenarios for generative recommendation through unified semantic IDs, lazy autoregressive decoding, and ranking-guided reinforcement learning.

relatedArticles.title: KAT-Coder-V2 Technical Report: Building Agentic Coding Models via the 'Specialize-then-Unify' Paradigm
relatedArticles.oneSentenceSummary: Kuaishou releases the KAT-Coder-V2 coding model, which integrates five domain-specific expert capabilities through a 'Specialize-then-Unify' paradigm, achieving state-of-the-art performance on benchmarks like SWE-bench.
